headings: Reliable boards and a clearer Origin
Live calls with your own key
Draft-first projects and clearer workspace controls
text: What's newRelease notes for the Origin desktop app.v0.2.152026-10-19Clearer provider usageQuota checks respect model accessUsage distinguishes unavailable subscription allowances from model sign-in. API-key, managed and separately authenticated connections no longer read another account's personal subscription quota. API-key activity remains available in History.Grok billing fallbackUsage keeps a valid Grok billing allowance when its separate credits endpoint refuses access. Unreported windows stay unknown.v0.2.142026-10-19Safer accounts and shared-agent ownershipSign-in stays with your accountA delayed sign-in or sign-out cannot replace a newer account, including when another window signs in and signs out before the old request finishes.Sessions stay on their serverChanging servers clears the previous session before connecting to the new server. Different addresses for the same server keep you signed in.Checked account connectionsConcurrent connection changes preserve the verified active account. Sign-in reports a failed connection to the local app so you can retry.Shared agents confirm ownershipShared work stops when Origin cannot renew its ownership. Queued and resumed work confirms ownership before starting, and changing accounts stops the previous local run.v0.2.132026-10-18Reliable boards and a clearer OriginReliable signup loadingSignup checks whether registration is available before showing its fields. A connection that does not respond offers Try again after ten seconds. Sign-in and verified invitations stay available.Safer Windows child processesWorkspace credentials stay out of installer and agent child processes even when environment names use different capitalization on Windows.Private provider logsStripe secret and restricted keys are hidden when agent protocol output is saved to logs.Accurate project listsWorkspace project lists refresh when a Chief's project links change, clearing stale entries from the sidebar.Stable issue draggingIssue cards stay visible when you drag quickly between columns. Losing edit access or switching projects cancels the drag before it can save a move.Protected conversationsIf saving a conversation change or deletion fails, Origin preserves its saved messages and metadata. Failed permission changes cannot grant broader access.Origin throughout the appStartup, tray menus, installation and agent messages use Origin's name. Unrelated subscription offers and promotional links are removed.Live calls with your own keyPhone and companion Live calls use your configured Live key without requiring an upstream subscription. Missing keys still open setup, and access checks still apply.Compact sidebar and server controlsFooter icons stay on one line. Saved server names remain readable in narrow windows, with their actions below when needed. The computer menu opens Origin's server settings.Origin server updatesSelf-hosted update checks find Origin releases and recognize their version tags. Docker instructions build the Origin checkout, and updates never suggest replacing Origin with the upstream npm package.Recoverable engine discoveryAn engine that never reports its status becomes unavailable after a minute instead of keeping engine discovery pending. Other engines remain available.v0.2.112026-10-18Draft-first projects and clearer workspace controlsDraft by defaultEvery project starts with Draft. New issues from the app, feedback, Chiefs and connected tools go to Draft unless you choose another column. Existing issues and imported history keep their destinations.Clean workspace deletionRemoving an empty local workspace also removes its leftover sidebar section. Startup cleans up old empty workspace sections, while preserving sections that contain bots, groups or a shared computer.Account and computer layoutYour account sits immediately before Search, with a full-width computer selector below. Footer actions wrap into aligned rows inside narrow sidebars.Consistent dialogs and menusAbout, Files, confirmations, Settings, Apps, Triggers, Voice and sidebar menus share the app's flat surfaces, borders and controls in light and dark themes.Reliable keyboard focusAccount menus focus correctly with reduced motion. Pending confirmations keep focus inside, and Triggers skips hidden Advanced controls when you press Tab.Readable triggers on phonesTrigger and agent names stay readable on narrow screens, with Copy link and the switch in their own row.Invitations from OriginHosted workspace invitations use the verified invites@origin.imbored.fun sender. If sending fails, Origin shows the delivery status and keeps the same invitation link available to share.Safer issue linksLegacy private ideas wait for Draft repair before GitHub mirroring. Older issue-creation requests preserve existing links or offer a manual creation page instead of risking duplicate GitHub issues.v0.2.102026-10-18Invitations and reliable desktop controlsPublic workspace invitationsLinks created or copied from the desktop open on origin.imbored.fun instead of localhost. Self-hosted connections use their own configured invitation website.Email invitationsEnter an email address to send an invitation through your Origin connection's email service. If email is unavailable or sending fails, the invitation stays available as a link you can share. Invitations expire after seven days.Clear join confirmationsA successful workspace join keeps its confirmation on screen. Switching invitations or accounts clears the previous result, and repeated clicks cannot submit the same join twice.Account and computer controlsYour account and computer selectors have their own row below the desktop title bar. Long account names stay inside the sidebar on Windows and Mac, and both menus remain easy to reach.Live activity receiptsActivity updates automatically after tools finish, including when a bot's task list refreshes. Switching bots or closing the panel cancels its pending work.v0.2.72026-10-18Safer workspaces and clearer controlsWorkspace and project permissionsViewer access is respected in chat and calls. Browser views close when access to their bot is removed. Access changes revoke shared agent runs, security changes revoke all other sessions, and project invitations grant the workspace access they need. Origin credentials stay out of engine child processes and error messages.Safer issue mirroringDraft issues stay private when their column is renamed. Repository issues complete through a verified pull request merge; closing an issue manually on GitHub does not mark it Done in Origin.Files respect their source accessUploads are tied to your account and destination, and sharing an existing file checks your current access to its source. Previously downloaded files and shared download links keep their existing behaviour.Shared work and syncAgent handoffs skip requests from people who no longer have access. Workspace sync ignores stale results after you change accounts or servers. Project imports recover after interrupted linking without creating another team of bots.Safer collaborative editingSwitching projects, accounts or servers clears private page state and locks the previous Vault. Saving an issue preserves a teammate's changes to fields you have not edited, and replacing an avatar keeps images still used elsewhere.Call continuityAn old machine or delayed leave response cannot interrupt your replacement call. If the browser blocks audio, a visible Play audio control lets you recover.Recoverable drawingsUnsaved scenes and images recover after navigation or reload, including interrupted saves. Canvas controls fit mobile screens, and closing an Ask preview cancels its pending snapshot.Consistent workspace controlsDialogs and issue menus have consistent keyboard and mobile behaviour. The website shares the app's light and dark palette, fonts and radii.Keyboard control in dialogsAbout, phone links, archived agents and Files dialogs keep keyboard focus inside and return it to the right control when closed. Nested confirmations keep their own keyboard focus, and menus support submenus in either placement.Readable buttons in every themeFilled buttons keep readable labels in every theme and with custom project colours. Hover and press feedback preserve their paired colours and keyboard focus rings.Files loading recoveryFiles shows a loading skeleton while it reads the desktop's state. A failed or stalled read offers Retry, and an old response cannot replace the recovered state.Responsive Data queriesReplacing a slow query or leaving its editor cancels the abandoned work even when Windows is busy. The next query can run, and the last committed result stays available.Chat attachments that fitWide images and long file names stay inside the conversation on small screens. Downloads keep the full original file name.Recoverable workspace loadingFailed or stalled reads offer a retry. A failed refresh keeps your loaded editor and unsaved draft, while revoked access closes the private page.Appearance from paired devicesPaired devices can save bot colours, mascots and avatar framing. Invalid values are rejected, and appearance changes do not grant access to execution settings.Clearer connection errorsRemote MCP connection errors include safe HTTP status codes and practical recovery hints. Malformed connection addresses never echo embedded credentials.Accurate browser setupBrowser version checks use the supported build for your operating system, so Windows no longer asks you to replace its correctly pinned browser engine.Release history everywhereWhat's new tracks the version you have read. The app, website and desktop update feeds use one changelog, and desktop packaging checks that the current version has release notes.vdesktop-1.02026-10-16Origin on the desktopProjects with default agentsEvery project starts with its own team of agents, ready to pick up work the moment you create it. Reorder them, add your own or start from a template team.WorkspacesKeep separate workspaces for separate parts of your life or business, and switch between them from the top of the sidebar.Zap Liquid avatarsGive each agent a Zap face in the Minimal or Liquid glass style, with its own colours, mascot shape and gaze.Inbox, Chat, Call and DrawOne Inbox for what needs you, chat with any agent, call it live by voice, or sketch together on a shared canvas.v1.02026-09-27A sharper workspaceKeyboard firstC creates an issue. F, / or Cmd/Ctrl + K opens search. Enter opens the best match; arrow keys choose another result. In chat, typing returns to your message.A cleaner issue editorCreate issues from one compact row. Choose a project when starting outside a project, and select a priority explicitly. Searchable menus and mobile-sized date controls keep everything consistent.A calmer sidebarRefined spacing, rounded-square avatars and a resizable sidebar. Your avatar moves with the project selection. Drag the sidebar edge left to collapse it, then use the top-left button to keep it open again.One Inbox, two viewsIssues and notifications share the Inbox; empty notifications stay collapsed. Switch between List and Calendar beside Active and Completed, keeping your project and priority filters. Issue rows stay borderless until you hover.Small details, fixedNo extra borders while typing, no background flash in issue descriptions, and no leftover project highlight when collapsing the project list.
